sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx:Quality Checks!A5:D5 and Internal Quality Checks!A5:D5
evidence: The public brief and six notes cover the product features graded in the other criteria. instruction.md:3-5 gives /assets/seed_data.json, /app, /, and no sign-in; integration.md:3 gives node /app/server.js, 0.0.0.0:3000, and GET /api/health; overview.md:3 and policy.md:3 establish a shared workspace without accounts; behaviour.md:9-11 and integration.md:7 require durable saved revisions. No time-based product rule needs a fixed clock. Two gaps remain. First, tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:32 requires a successful application write response containing exact title, filename and source; the public behaviour.md:9 requires those exact fields to be saved, while integration.md:5 expressly leaves routes open and policy.md:3 leaves schema and error wording open. The public contract never requires a write response to echo the fields. This is a zero-weight hard gate with all_pass aggregation (constraints/judge.toml:14-15), so a compliant save can receive zero reward. Second, the public integration.md:3-9 omits DB_PATH despite tests/test.sh:98-110 and 160-167 injecting it into both launches and the frozen workbook Quality Checks row 4 and staged-task-contract.md Cross-file agreements requiring that runtime fact to be stated. The frozen template integration.md:7-8 states it explicitly. No full configured judge run was performed for this row; raw-evidence-index.json was absent when checked.
counterexample: A conforming app can accept Save with HTTP 204 or a response containing only a record ID, then persist the exact title, filename and source and show them from a fresh server read in a clean browser context. It fulfills the public notes yet fails the literal write-response clause of the Constraints hard gate. Conversely, an app that echoes all fields in its write response and shares them across tabs only in process memory can pass that gate despite failing the publicly required server-restart durability; the later scored restart criterion may catch it, but the gate itself does not.
suggested_fix: Change the Constraints save gate to require a successful write plus exact independent-context server readback, without mandating an echo in the write response; state the required DB_PATH behavior in the public integration note, including the intended default path if one is required.
